images.title: Drawing a 30° angle
images.purpose: Show the finished angle ∠TIN of 30° with ray IN as the base.
images.composition: One angle drawn large and centred with its arc and label.
images.exact_structure: A horizontal base ray in teal #0072B2 from point I to point N on the right. A second ray in teal #0072B2 from point I rising at exactly 30° to point T. A small amber #E69F00 arc at I between the rays. Exactly 2 rays, 3 points I, N and T, 1 arc.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Start at the base, turn 30°, join.
images.description: A base ray IN and a second ray IT making an angle of 30° at the vertex I, with the arc marked 30°.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the vertex I, the base ray IN and then the turn of 30°.

image_decisions.why: The idea is a picture of the angle itself; one clean image carries it.
